# Physio to Home

> Physio to Home provides professional in-home physiotherapy across Tasmania, Australia. AHPRA-registered physiotherapists deliver personalised assessment, treatment and rehabilitation in clients' homes, aged care facilities and workplaces — no GP referral required.

Physio to Home serves clients across Launceston, Hobart, the North West Coast, and rural Tasmania. Services cover back, neck and joint pain, post-surgery rehabilitation, falls prevention, neurological rehabilitation, aged care physiotherapy, and chronic pain management.

Funding accepted: Medicare (Chronic Disease Management Plans), DVA, NDIS (self and plan managed), My Aged Care Home Care Packages, WorkCover, private health insurance, and private payment.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.physiotohome.com/): overview of services, coverage area and how to book
- [Services](https://www.physiotohome.com/services): full list of physiotherapy services offered
- [Team](https://www.physiotohome.com/team): AHPRA-registered physiotherapists on staff
- [Blog](https://www.physiotohome.com/blog): physiotherapy advice and health guides
- [Booking](https://www.physiotohome.com/booking): book an in-home appointment
- [Contact](https://www.physiotohome.com/contact): phone, email and contact form
